div.head: Wl ep 4
div.ab: Hoc etiam defendo et mea auctoritate interdico, ne ullus uicecomes aut prepositus seu minister regis nec aliquis laicus homo de legibus que ad episcopum pertinent se intromittat.
Hoc etiam defendo et mea auctoritate interdico, ne ullus vicecomes aut praepositus seu minister regis nec aliquis laicus homo de legibus quae ad episcopum pertinent se intromittat.
I likewise forbid and, by my authority, prohibit any sheriff or reeve or baron or any layman from interfering with the jurisdiction which belongs to the bishop.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 236–237 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 485, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
